title: Co-Authoring with AI: How I Wrote a Physics Paper About AI, Using AI
summary: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into scientific writing fundamentally challenges traditional definitions of authorship, responsibility, and scientific integrity. As researchers transition from using computers as deterministic tools to managing them as ``virtual collaborators,'' the nature of human contribution must be re-evaluated. Using the drafting process of a recent computational physics manuscript as a case study, this essay explores the indispensable role of the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL).
